Everything below comes from `AGENTS.md` and the docs it routes to, mainly `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its example. I didn't open any source files, so line numbers are the doc anchors and may have drifted.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` (near `ShopTransactionBody:159`) | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }`. Add a cost constant such as `REST_COST_GOLD`. The cost is my placeholder; the docs set no value, and the Worker should own it. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Add `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. Validate the body and call `getCharacter` (`services/character.ts:86`). Return 404 if the character is missing. Return 400 if `gold < REST_COST_GOLD`. Then call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`). That function only accepts the whitelisted fields hp, xp, gold, level, max_hp, ac and abilities. Return `{ success, cost, updatedCharacter }`. Optionally call `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory`, `saveSession` and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (route mounts, lines 41-48) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. CORS (lines 19-35) needs no change. |

- **Optional guards:** reject the rest if HP is already full, so no gold is spent. Also reject it while the session has an active `CombatState` in KV. Neither rule is in the docs, so both are design choices.
- **No migration:** `characters` already has `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold`, so `worker/migrations/` stays untouched.
- **Shared logic:** only move it into `worker/src/services/character.ts` if another route will reuse it.

## Docs to update in the same change
- **New doc:** `docs/code/worker/src/routes/rest.md`.
- **Existing docs:** update the docs beside each changed file.
- **Index:** add an entry in `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- **Specs and routing:** update `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec). Also update the `AGENTS.md` routing table and `docs/flows/inventory.md` if you treat this as a new feature area.

`CharacterStateService` and `character-sheet` need no code changes, because they already re-render from `setCharacter`.
